"""Camera-guided waypoint controller for the frozen RoboCasa episode.

Usage: python gen.py label left/right world_x world_y world_z [steps] [grip]
The last issued command holds the other hand and both orientations.
"""
import json
import sys
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = '/app/output'
R = np.array([[0.,-1.,0.],[1.,0.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])
T = np.array([2.65,-2.175,.97])

def base(world):
    return R.T @ (np.asarray(world)-T)

def command_from_obs(obs):
    p=obs.meta['proprio']; d=dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
    names=['right_x','right_y','right_z','right_rx','right_ry','right_rz',
           'left_x','left_y','left_z','left_rx','left_ry','left_rz',
           'right_little','right_ring','right_middle','right_index','right_thumb_flexion','right_thumb_rotation',
           'left_little','left_ring','left_middle','left_index','left_thumb_flexion','left_thumb_rotation']
    return np.array([d['cmd_'+n] for n in names],float)

def main():
    label, arm = sys.argv[1:3]
    xyz=np.array([float(x) for x in sys.argv[3:6]])
    steps=int(sys.argv[6]) if len(sys.argv)>6 else 40
    grip=float(sys.argv[7]) if len(sys.argv)>7 else None
    r=Robot(); obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['egoview'],video='none')
    start=command_from_obs(obs);end=start.copy();off=0 if arm=='right' else 6
    end[off:off+3]=base(xyz)
    if grip is not None:end[12 if arm=='right' else 18:18 if arm=='right' else 24]=grip
    A=np.linspace(start,end,steps)
    cams=['egoview','robot0_agentview_left','robot0_agentview_right','robot0_eye_in_right_hand','robot0_eye_in_left_hand']
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',A,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label)
    path=f'{OUT}/{label}';res.save(path)
    p=res.meta['proprio'];d=dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
    print(json.dumps({'label':label,'steps':res.meta['control_steps'],'time_left_s':res.meta['time_left_s'],
                      'eef_left':[d['eef_left_'+c] for c in 'xyz'],
                      'eef_right':[d['eef_right_'+c] for c in 'xyz'],
                      'left_fingers':[d['gripper0_left_L_'+n+'_pos'] for n in ('index_proximal_joint','thumb_proximal_pitch_joint')],
                      'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped')},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
